bare-deactivate-route-filter.definition: the device's display set prints an inactive route-filter as a bare `deactivate` with no `set` line for it

escaped-quote-lost.definition: a value holding an escaped quote `\"` is written with bare inner quotes, which does not load

inactive-keyed-entry-name-leak.definition: from curly input, the same entry is written `... routing-instance R name`

inactive-keyed-entry-repeated.definition: from set input, an inactive keyed entry such as `port-mirroring ... routing-instance R` is written `... routing-instance R R`

junos-variable-quoted.definition: junoscfg quotes `$junos-...` variables the device prints bare; the device loads both as the same configuration

omitted-block-emitted.definition: from curly input, the device's `{ /* OMITTED */ }` placeholder is written as a set line instead of being reported

omitted-curly.definition: the device's curly prints a group with `apply-flags omit` as `/* OMITTED */`, so the curly rendering lacks that group's content; XML, JSON and set carry it

overload-timeout-dropped.definition: `isis overload timeout N` is written `overload N`, which the device rejects

policy-expression-double-quoted.definition: from XML, a policy expression is written `""( P )""`, which does not load

policy-expression-quoted.definition: a single-term policy expression `( P )` is written `"( P )"`, which the device reads as a policy name

policy-name-unquoted.definition: the quoted policy name `"( A && B )"` is written unquoted, which the device reads as an expression

radius-timeout-dropped.definition: `radius-server <address> timeout N` is written `radius-server <address> N`, which the device accepts and loads without the timeout

transport-class-dict.definition: `routing-options transport-class name N ...` is written with a Python dict as the name, and every entry after the first is lost; a JSON number stays a number inside it

trigger-after-one-line.definition: junoscfg writes `within N trigger after 1` as one set line where the device prints two; whether set input loads both alike needs a device load test

trigger-after-split.definition: the device's display set prints `within N trigger after 1` as two lines, `... trigger after` and `... trigger 1`; curly, XML and JSON hold one statement

xml-element-name-leak.definition: from XML or JSON, an element the CLI hides appears in the set path (rf_list, server-group server-group, other-variables, bridge-domains domain, dynamic-tunnels dynamic-tunnel, hello-padding-type); the same statements curly input reports as not placed in the schema

xml-empty-value-lost.definition: from XML, `description ""` is written as a bare `description`

xml-value-whitespace-lost.definition: from XML, leading or trailing spaces in a value are stripped (`"^show "` becomes `"^show"`)
